reasoning_content:
The user wants me to implement a more rigorous architecture where:

1. Supabase is the ONLY source of truth in frontend (with a clear feature flag for fallback)
2. Separate provider ingestion status from frontend provider filter
3. Canonicalize source names firmly in one place
4. Move source normalization to ingestion, not api-server
5. Add clear metadata in /supabase-events
6. Add hard verification of the ingestion chain
7. Make /events clearly a legacy/debug endpoint
8. Add "ingestion freshness" to health
9. Unify event shape between API and frontend
10. Prioritize getting more sources through ingestion before improving dropdown/UI

Let me implement these changes systematically.

task_list.title: 1. Feature flag for Supabase-only in frontend
task_list.notes: USE_SUPABASE_ONLY=true, no fallback unless flag is false

task_list.title: 5. Add source verification logging
task_list.notes: fetch count, queued, normalized, upserted, published counts

task_list.notes: Remove from api-server, add to normalizer.ts

task_list.title: 7. Unify event shape
task_list.notes: Ensure consistent fields between API and frontend
